gloss: to defect; to turn against; to become estranged
notes:
Describes the process of supporters, allies, or members breaking away from a group or leader. Implies that loyalty or support existed before and has been withdrawn. Very common in political and organizational contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{支持者|しじしゃ}→支持者：17852_shijisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{離反|りはん}→離反：21482_rihan⟧: defection of supporters
- ⟦{離反|りはん}→離反：21482_rihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧: to invite/cause defection
- ～⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{離反|りはん}する: to turn against ~, to break away from ~
- ⟦{離反|りはん}→離反：21482_rihan⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧: act of defection
- {民心|みんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{離反|りはん}→離反：21482_rihan⟧: alienation of the public

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裏切|うらぎ}る→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧: to betray — stronger; implies treachery and breaking trust
- ⟦{脱退|だったい}→脱退：05770_dattai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to withdraw, to quit — more neutral; formally leaving an organization
- ⟦{反旗|はんき}→反旗：11988_hanki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{翻|ひるがえ}す→翻す：10519_hirugaesu⟧: to raise the flag of revolt — a more dramatic expression for rebelling
- ⟦{疎遠|そえん}→疎遠：08372_soen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become estranged — gradual drifting apart without active rebellion

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of {離|り} (separate, leave) + ⟦{反|はん}→反〜：03964_han⟧ (oppose, rebel).

definitions.gloss: to defect; to turn against; to become estranged
definitions.explanation: to break away from a group, leader, or cause one previously supported; to become disloyal or estranged
